title: [3.0-beta1] Incorrect COB
symptom: After entering a food bolus of 35g carbs, the COB (Carbs on Board) displayed as 60g instead of 35g, and the carb graph appears doubled.
cause: The issue was caused by a bug in the code that doubled the carb entries, as indicated by the doubled carb graph and the fix commit.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit (345a57da09453c4528a470f669e192d048fddc18) in the AndroidAPS repository.
